turns.reply: Kitchenmate Prime Mixer Grinder is the cheapest at ₹2,039, though Kitchenmate Eco Mixer Grinder offers a longer 5-year warranty with a higher 4.4 rating for ₹2,239.

arguments.headline: 3 Cheapest Mixer Grinders
arguments.reply: Kitchenmate Prime Mixer Grinder is the cheapest at ₹2,039, though Kitchenmate Eco Mixer Grinder offers a longer 5-year warranty with a higher 4.4 rating for ₹2,239.

turns.user: Which brands are the first two, and which suits daily chutney and masala better?
turns.reply: The first two are from Kitchenmate and Tava. Kitchenmate Prime Mixer Grinder is better suited for tough daily grinding like masalas and chutneys thanks to its higher 947 W motor compared to Tava's 681 W.

result.title: Kitchenmate Prime Mixer Grinder
result.description: It's easy to clean and simple to use. Kitchenmate covers it with a 3 years warranty. This mixer grinder is rated at 947 W.

result.title: Tava Prime Mixer Grinder
result.description: Tava covers it with a 3 years warranty. It has a capacity of 0.8 L. It's easy to clean and simple to use.
